summary: AXIA Energia S.A. (formerly Brazilian Electric Power Co.), a Brazilian electric utility, filed a Form 6-K reporting that ADR trading on the OTC market commenced on August 7, 2026, under tickers AXIAY (common) and AXICY (Class C preferred). Concurrently, the company filed Form 15F with the SEC to terminate its Section 12(g) registration and suspend reporting obligations, with deregistration expected effective 90 days after filing. This voluntary deregistration transitions the company from SEC reporting to a more limited OTC ADR status. No financial terms, premiums, or advisors were disclosed. Watch for the deregistration effective date and continued market updates.
